hints.title: Maximum Value Permutation
hints.text: Rearranging the decimal digits of an integer descending gives the maximum possible value achievable from those digits.

hints.title: Gain per Operation
hints.text: For each number x, the net increase gained by applying the rearrangement operation is max_val(x) - x.

hints.title: Top-K Greedy Selection
hints.text: Sort the potential gains in descending order and greedily add the largest k positive gains to the baseline sum.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Greedy gain ranking where d is the max digit length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing subsets of indices with combinations causes combinatorial blowup.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting gains array of size n takes O(n log n).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that each number can be optimized independently to produce a deterministic gain.
